text: APPROVE. The refactor splits the old `foreach` over `{-1, 1}` into `IsSetLiveInDirection`, and the inner `break` becomes `return false`. The `||` still checks the backward direction first and then the forward one, so behaviour is unchanged. `IsAlsoSetLive` is now trivial, and the new helper scores about 10 by my hand count, under the threshold of 15. The new method is private, so there's no missing-doc warning to trip warnings-as-errors. I did not run the build or the tests, so the build condition rests on reading the diff.
